verdict.rationale: Rive is a design and animation editor, so exporting production assets is a fair question for it. The evidence only documents exporting a .riv file for Rive's runtimes, and community comments note the lack of other export formats. Nothing shows PNG, SVG, or PDF export, per-layer export presets, scale multipliers, or slices, and runtime-file export is a different capability.

support.subject: As a designer, I can export production assets — PNG, SVG, PDF, and more — with per-layer presets, scales, and slices
